description: Live OpenRouter provider reliability lookup and routing instructions for tool calling and structured outputs (providers.dottxt.ai). Fetch current model JSON via llms.txt, validate status and valid_until expiry, cite the as_of observation date, and merge OpenRouter provider.order/ignore settings while preserving privacy and policy constraints.
rules: Never use cached, remembered, or indexed provider rankings or error rates as current routing advice. Always fetch https://providers.dottxt.ai/llms.txt to find the target model's models/{name}.json link, then fetch that live JSON file directly.
Act on a model's recommendation only when status is 'ok' and the current UTC time is strictly before valid_until; otherwise report status_reason and do not recommend a routing configuration.
Always cite the model JSON's as_of observation date alongside measured error rates, sample sizes, and confidence.

Use top-level invalid_tool_call_rate and recommendation for tool calling; use structured_outputs (structured_output_error_rate and its own status, valid_until, and recommendation) for response_format / structured-output workloads.

When updating an OpenRouter provider configuration, replace order and ignore, remove sort, and preserve existing policy and capability constraints (allow_fallbacks, require_parameters, data_collection, zdr, enforce_distillable_text, quantizations, max_price, preferred_min_throughput, preferred_max_latency, and only). Flag conflicts rather than weakening constraints.
Scope these instructions to OpenRouter provider selection, routing updates, and OpenRouter tool-call or structured-output failures — not unrelated local JSON parsing or schema bugs.
